subject: Model evaluation follow-up & regression after recent model update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie@retailco.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Model evaluation follow-up & recommended next steps

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — great to learn more about RetailCo's use cases for product Q&A and returns triage. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recommended models to try for your prompt set: redwood-model-x-1.0 (quantized), open-metrics/gpt-retail-1.0 (non-quantized).
- Shared a standard prompt set we discussed (retail_prompt_set_v1.txt) and a short bench CSV template (benchmark_results_summary.csv) for results.
- Suggested evals: 1) accuracy on your closed-book FAQ set, 2) response stability on session continuity prompts, 3) latency/throughput targets (p95 <= 250ms for single-turn).

Links and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retail-evals (bench template + prompt set).

Next steps: 
1) Jamie - run the attached prompt set and return the benchmark CSV with any qualitative notes (we can take it from there).
2) We'll run side-by-side comparisons against the redwood-model-x-1.0 baseline and share a short diff report.

I've cc'd Ethan to support any infra/rollout questions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: benchmark_results_summary.csv (CSV), retail_prompt_set_v1.txt (TXT)

From: Jamie Carter <jamie@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model evaluation follow-up & recommended next steps

Thanks Marissa — quick update from our team after running the prompt set.

Summary: we ran the shared prompt set against your current production model (redwood-model-x-1.1) and the redwood-model-x-1.0 baseline. Results are attached (eval_results_v1.csv). Key observation: we see a regression on several quality metrics after the 1.1 update. For our retail FAQ set:
- F1 (intent match): 87.2 (1.0) -> 81.4 (1.1)
- Answer correctness (manual sample): 94% (1.0) -> 86% (1.1)
- Notable failures: entity normalization changes and occasional hallucinations on product SKUs.

Given this delta, we are concerned about the impact to our customer experience and would like to request immediate mitigation options. Priority asks:
1) Can you run a quick diff to highlight spike causes?
2) Can Redwood pin our traffic to redwood-model-x-1.0 (or rollback 1.1) while we investigate?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is a high-priority issue for our CSAT work.

Thanks,
Jamie
Principal Product Manager | RetailCo
jamie@retailco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Model evaluation follow-up & recommended next steps — regression on 1.1

Ethan/Vivek — looping you in because RetailCo reported a clear quality regression after our 1.1 rollout. Jamie attached eval_results_v1.csv (attached to thread) and asked for a pin/rollback.

Quick context: this is a high-touch expansion opportunity (DEAL-2027-0091). We need a fast mitigation plan and a small root cause triage. Proposed immediate actions: 
- Ethan: can we pin RetailCo's routing to redwood-model-x-1.0 for their tenant and push a rollback if pinning isn't sufficient? Please confirm ETA.
- Vivek: can you have the model infra team run a diff on 1.0 vs 1.1 focusing on tokenization/normalization, decoding changes, and any prompt preprocessing adjustments? If there's a known change that could explain the SKU hallucinations, flag it.
- I'll coordinate comms with Jamie and schedule a short follow-up call for Monday to review findings.

I attached a template for a diff report (diff_report.pdf) — please populate with observed deltas and recommended next steps. Also include a note on whether we should do a canary rollback (10% traffic) vs full pin.

We need to move quickly here — Jamie is rightly concerned about CSAT impact. Let me know status by EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: diff_report.pdf (PDF)

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jamie Carter <jamie@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model evaluation follow-up & regression on 1.1 — rollback/pin complete

Hi all,

Quick status: we executed an emergency pin for RetailCo routing to redwood-model-x-1.0 at 15:00 PT today. Traffic is now pinned and we're monitoring. Change log:
- Action taken: Updated routing policy for account RetailCo to force model_version=redwood-model-x-1.0 (pin) and created a canary rollback job in case we need gradual reintroduction.
- Infra/ops ETA: pin applied immediately; monitoring dashboards show error rates and latency within expected bounds.
- Next steps: infra run a differential A/B test across 1.0 vs 1.1 in a controlled environment and populate diff_report.pdf with low-level traces. Engineering suspects a tokenizer normalizer change in 1.1 that affects SKU formatting; Vivek's team will validate.

Jamie — we will follow up with a short report and a proposed remediation plan (patch vs roll back) by EOD Wednesday. For now your production traffic should be stable on 1.0.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com
